note: Internal lookup index for agent-ready-site, not an external standard. Recheck an entry's source before it drives a recommendation; drafts and agent tokens move. probe_site.py reads probe_paths, expect, and agents from this file.

policies.recommended: Recommend when a wanted agent class runs a job the capability serves.
policies.conditional: Recommend only when the entry's condition holds.
policies.report-only: Report presence; recommend only for an explicit product goal.
policies.not-applicable-unless: Skip unless the entry's condition holds.
policies.avoid: No documented consumer. Never recommend; flag when present only if it causes cloaking, drift, or maintenance cost.

capabilities.label: Content Signals (robots.txt Content-Signal)
capabilities.consumers: Declares search, ai-input, and ai-train preferences; no enforcement.
capabilities.condition: The owner has a stated preference for search, AI input, or AI training use.

capabilities.label: Web Bot Auth key directory
capabilities.maturity: IETF draft on HTTP Message Signatures (RFC 9421).
capabilities.consumers: CDNs and sites that verify signed agents.
capabilities.condition: The organization operates its own crawler or agent that signs requests. A site that only receives agents verifies signatures at its CDN or server instead.

capabilities.label: HTTP Link header
capabilities.consumers: Headless agents that read response headers.
capabilities.condition: Announces a markdown alternate or an api-catalog.

capabilities.label: Markdown content negotiation (Accept: text/markdown)
capabilities.maturity: HTTP content negotiation (RFC 9110); CDN support such as Cloudflare Markdown for Agents.
capabilities.consumers: Claude Code, OpenCode, and Cursor send Accept: text/markdown by default (Cloudflare, 2026-04).
capabilities.condition: Fetch agents are a wanted class.

capabilities.label: Declared markdown alternate (link rel=alternate type=text/markdown, .md routes)
capabilities.maturity: Convention; .md routes come from the llms.txt proposal.
capabilities.consumers: Tools that read head links or follow llms.txt links.
capabilities.condition: Fetch agents are a wanted class.

capabilities.label: llms.txt
capabilities.consumers: Tools and agents pointed at it by a user or doc; few crawlers fetch it unprompted.
capabilities.condition: Docs, developer, or API product, or a content site with a curated index worth maintaining.

capabilities.label: llms-full.txt
capabilities.consumers: Coding agents loading a whole docs set.
capabilities.condition: Docs set small enough to ship as one file.

capabilities.label: schema.org JSON-LD
capabilities.consumers: Search engines. A 2025 controlled test found major assistants missed product facts present only in JSON-LD.
capabilities.condition: Supports visible facts; never the only copy of a fact.

capabilities.label: OAuth authorization server metadata
capabilities.condition: Agents act on user accounts through an API or MCP server.

capabilities.label: OpenID Connect discovery
capabilities.condition: The site is an OpenID provider.

capabilities.label: OAuth protected resource metadata
capabilities.consumers: MCP clients discovering authorization for a remote server.
capabilities.condition: Protected API or remote MCP server.

capabilities.label: Remote MCP server
capabilities.condition: Jobs that should run without an open page.

capabilities.label: MCP server card
capabilities.maturity: MCP SEP draft (SEP-1649, SEP-2127); the path changed between drafts.
capabilities.consumers: Some MCP clients and agent-readiness scanners.

capabilities.label: Agent Skills discovery index
capabilities.condition: Developer product that publishes Agent Skills.

capabilities.label: A2A agent card
capabilities.condition: The product is an agent with a task lifecycle.

capabilities.label: WebMCP in-page tools
capabilities.consumers: Browser agents in supporting Chrome builds.
capabilities.condition: Recommend only for repeated, high-value do jobs; implementation belongs to web-agent-ready.

capabilities.label: meta name=llms or meta name=ai-content-url
capabilities.maturity: WHATWG request closed as not planned; no specification for ai-content-url.

capabilities.label: HTML comments, hidden text, or AI-only pages addressed to agents
capabilities.consumers: None documented; parsers strip comments. Hidden agent-only text is a cloaking and injection risk.

capabilities.label: Markdown served by user-agent sniffing
capabilities.consumers: Treated as cloaking by search engines. Use Accept negotiation instead.

agents.name: Google-Extended
agents.purpose: Gemini training and grounding control; robots.txt token only

agents.name: Applebot-Extended
agents.purpose: Apple AI training control; robots.txt token only
